wizard.title: Database Setup Wizard
wizard.info: This wizard guides you through the database setup process.
wizard.infoDetail: Steps must be executed in the specified order. The last step (GymNet Presets) is optional.
wizard.createDatabaseDesc: Creates a new PostgreSQL database with the configured settings
wizard.testConnectionDesc: Tests the connection to the database and ensures it is reachable
wizard.createSchemaDesc: Initializes all 15+ tables with relationships and constraints (Prisma migrate deploy)
wizard.gymnetPresetDesc: Populates the database with 60+ devices, formulas, and fields for GymNet import (optional)
wizard.disciplineGroupsDesc: Creates standard groups (4-apparatus, 6-apparatus) for P-competition and performance classes (optional, requires production disciplines)
wizard.sampleDataDesc: Creates one sample record each for country, association, region, club, participant, venue, and certificate layout (optional)
wizard.standardCountriesDesc: Imports 34 standard countries (DACH, Europe, FIG nations) for the country list in associations
wizard.completeDetail: Your database is now ready to use. Click "Use New DB & Save" to apply the configuration and reconnect the server.
wizard.savedAndReconnectedDetail: The new database is now in use. The server is restarting – please wait a moment and then reload the page.
wizard.newDbOnlyDetail: This wizard is intended for initial setup of new databases only. Existing databases with data are not supported. Disciplines, status types, and discipline groups are only imported into empty tables.
wizard.skippedWarningIntro: Without the skipped steps, the following limitations may occur:
wizard.skippedWarning1: GymNet import cannot correctly map apparatus/disciplines (missing device IDs and formulas)
wizard.skippedWarning2: Genders may be marked as "unknown" (missing area/gender assignments)
wizard.skippedWarning3: Some features may not work correctly: statistics, apparatus assignments, automatic squad assignment, discipline group filters
wizard.skippedWarningHint: Recommendation: Reset the wizard and execute all steps to ensure full functionality.
